commits.message: ManagerAPI: Updated package.json packages to mitigate security vulnerabilities.
ComponentAPI: Updated logging configuration so that log file writes are buffered.
Added Grafana Loki container to docker-compose file for centralised log management. Loki UI is exposed on http://localhost:3000.
ComponentAPI: changed log formatter to RenderedCompactJsonFormatter to reduce unncessesary logging data.
Replaced use of InMemoryDateTimePriorityQueue with interface to allow for easier unit testing.
Updated front end dependencies.
Updated SchedulerRequestProcessor tests to cover cases found by Stryker
Added ActiveSockets assertion to StreamManager tests to cover case found by Stryker.
Made SchedulerRequest.Paths immutable and removed unnecessary mutation from SchedulerRequesProcessor.
RabbitMQ: Removed unused argument from RabbitMQChannelPool.GetPooledChannel()
Added more methods to stryker config ignore list.
ManagerAPI: Visiting the website root now redirects to the SPA main page /app.
Updatred InMemoryDateTimePriorityQueue tests to cover cases found by Stryker.
Updated RobotsClient tests to cover cases found by Stryker.
Updated FakeHttpMessageHandler and related customizations to be able to take a list of allowed uris. The handler will throw if it receives a URI not on the allowed list.
Updated RobotsDownloaderRequestProcessor tests to cover cases found by Stryker.
Updated IngestRequestProcessor tests to cover cases found by Stryker.
Removed redundant code from InMemoryCrawlerManager.
Added InMemoryKeyValueStore tests to cover cases found by Stryker.
Updated FallbackEncodingHandler tests to cover cases found by Stryker.
Removed redundant code and updated ParserRequestProcessor tests to cover cases found by Stryker.
Added InMemoryEventReceiver tests to cover cases found by Stryker.
Added more assertions to RobotsDownloaderRequestProcessor tests to cover cases found by Stryker.
Added RobotsCacheReader tests to cover cases found by Stryker.
Updated NodeStatusProviderTests to ensure NodeStatus properties are assigned the correct values.
Added unit test for EventReceiverCollection.GetEnumerator.
Updated ByteCountingStreamTests to cover cases found by Stryker.
Added DomainPattern tests to more thoroughly validate wildcard matching behaviour.
Added ContentStore tests to cover cases where a given key is not present
Made IngestSuccess.MediaType and IngestFailure.MediaType nullable to differentiate the case where a Content-Type header is present with no value and no Content-Type header is present at all.
Added a stryker config for mutation testing.

Added a DEV_MODE environment variable which overrides the DevMode config setting. The DevMode setting is now set to true by default and the environment variable is set to false in the docker-compose config. This means the ManagerAPI project and the docker-compose project can be run without changing the default settings.
Added more properties to the logging scope invoked when processing an item in SchedulerIngestQueue
ManagerAPI: Refactored logging code to output uncaught exceptions and flush the log before exiting.
ComponentAPI: Refactored logging code to output uncaught exceptions and flush the log before exiting.
Console: Refactored logging code to output uncaught exceptions and flush the log before exiting.
Console logging output is now in an easy to read format.
Added a TraceId to RequestBase. All requests that are produced from a given SchedulerRequest share the same TraceId. This makes it easier to query logs for related requests.
BeginComponentInfoScope() and BeginRequestScope() now only inject properties without a message template, as this just needlessly clutters the log.
Updated logging so that log entries contain information about the current request and the current component where appropriate.
Refactored Request classes so that URI is in the base class.
Bump Microsoft.AspNetCore.SpaServices.Extensions version 6.0.1 -> 6.0.2.
Bump Scrutor version 3.3.0 -> 4.0.0.
Bump RabbitMQ.Client version 6.2.2 -> 6.2.3.
Bump Polly version 7.2.2 -> 7.2.3.
Update Core.Tests dependencies to latest versions.
Bump Nager.PublicSuffix 2.2.2 -> 2.3.0.
Replaced NLog with Serilog.
Fixed default ComponentAPI nlog.config so that duplicate messages are no longer output to the console.
Removed unused NodeInfo typescript interface.
Frontend: Added the ability to turn individual components on and off from the frontend. This needs to be improved with debouncing / throttling.
Made ComponentFilter.Matches case insensitive when matching on component name.
Fixed inverted logic error in RabbitMQComponentDecorator

Reworked ManagerAPI to reduce amount of duplicated data sent. An OnComponentUpdate event is now fired when any component has an update and a collection containing all updated components is sent, rather than being sent as individual events.
Fixed issue where RabbitMQComponentDecorator would not handle a RabbitMQCommand with an empty ComponentFilter correctly.
Github now handles .tst files correctly when calculating repo language stats.
Create codeql-analysis.yml
Added a basic github action to run build and test steps for C# code
Increased Timeout in ByteCountingStream EndRead test from 1 millisecond to 1 second. The short timeout was causing the GitHub test action to fail.
Fixed issue with URI parsing on Linux, due to Uri.TryCreate behaviour not being consistent across all platforms.
Added a trait to StreamManagerTests to mark them as Integration tests, so that they can be filtered out when testing within a CI pipeline.
Updated front end dependencies.
Removed duplicate namespace definition.
Made SchedulerIngestQueue disposable to allow the queue thread to exit gracefully.
Frontend now gets the current status for all components immediately when the page is first loaded. The pause/resume toggle is also updated to reflect the current status of the components.
Removed unused OnCrawlerStateChanged event definition from IComponentEventsHub
Added an optional onConnectedCallback to setupSignalRConnection.
Added the current component status (Paused/Running etc) to ComponentStatus, so it can be seen on a ComponentUpdate event.
Changed the values of CrawlerComponentStats to Unknown, NotStarted, Paused, Running and Completed and modified TaskQueueComponent.Status report the appropriate value.
Introduced explicit PauseComponent and ResumeComponent  to CrawlerController and CrawlerHub rather than using an optional parameter.
Refactored ComponentFilter so that an empty instance won't match anything and the singleton instance ComponentFilter.MatchAll will match everything.
CrawlerController and CommandHub Pause() and Resume() methods can now take an optional ComponentFilter to allow components to be controlled selectively.
Renamed SchedulerAutoDataAttribute -> SchedulerRequestProcessorAutoDataAttribute.
Refactored SchedulerRequestProcessorCustomization so that SchedulerSettings can be used by other tests.
Removed unnecessary null handling from FallbackEncodingHandler.
Fixed potential race condition in ProducerExtensions.Enqueue where an item could be processed by the producer before the required callback was added.
Added tests for NodeStatusProvider.

Added tests for StreamManager.

Note these are closer to integration tests than unit tests, as the only way to test the ConnectCallback is to make a call to an actual HTTP server.
Implemented old style async calls in ByteCountingStream (BeginRead/EndRead and BeginWrite/EndWrite)
Refactored exception handling in TaskQueueComponent to remove some redundant catches.
Moved ComponentFilter into the Models namespace, as it will be referenced directly by the frontend
Removed unused StartedAt property from StreamManager.
Moved ByteCountingStream and StreamManager out of the StreamManager namespace to avoid naming conflicts.
Added unit tests for SchedulerRequestProcessor.
Changed RobotsClient.TryGetRobotsAsync()  to make passing the CancellationToken optional.
SchedulerRequestProcessor: Removed a catch for a ParseException that isn't thrown anywhere.
Removed unused SchedulerQueueEntry record from SchedulerRequestProcessor. This had previously been moved to SchedulerIngestQueue.
Made immutable properties on IngestRrequest actually immutable.
Removed overly broad catch from RobotsClient that should never be used.
Updated RobotsClient tests to use a new CancellationTokenSource for every test rather than using a static one for all tests.
Add a test to RobotsClient to ensure correct behaviour around request timeouts.
Added unit tests for ByteCountingStream.
DisposeAsync now calls the dispose callback rather than just calling the implementation of the underlying stream.
ByteCountingStream.WriteByte() and ByteCountingStream.ReadByte() now call the underlying stream rather than the base implementation.
Refactored ByteCountingStream and StreamManager to make them more testable.
Added tests for new ComponentFilter functionality.
Extended ICrawlerManager and ICrawlerComponent to allow commands (Pause/Resume etc) to be applied selectively.
Added missing configuration settings to console app conffiguration.
Corrected outdated namespaces in logging configuration
Added EventReceiverFactory test case to cover the case where the ServiceProvider returns duplicate items.
